name: com.thebalancetoolkit
description: Receive Wii Balance Board center-of-pressure data from The Balance Toolkit desktop application over TCP or LSL and map it to GameObject movement. LSL support and the original demo are optional samples.

samples.description: Import, then choose Balance Toolkit Demo > Create TCP Example Scene.
LSL controller, plus LSL input for the Balance Toolkit Demo > Monitor monitor. Requires the LSL4Unity compatibility build; install it from Balance Toolkit Demo > Setup before importing.

Original art plus a demo scene generator, and the original URP effects, camera controls and benchmarks. Requires Unity 6.6. After importing, choose Balance Toolkit Demo > Create Demo Scene for a playable scene (the original TBT.unity is incomplete). The effects, camera controls and benchmarks compile only when URP 17, Cinemachine 3, Input System and Timeline are installed; install them from Balance Toolkit Demo > Setup.
